description: Private 3-day tour from Surabaya: Surabaya → Tumpak Sewu Waterfall → Bromo sunrise  → Surabaya. All-inclusive. Tourist Police-led operator.
inclusions: Private Transport: Air-conditioned private vehicles (MPV for 1-3 guests, Minibus for 4-11 guests) with a dedicated driver. This includes fuel, tolls, and parking fees.
Tour Guides: Experienced English-speaking guides. For 1-3 guests, a driver-guide. For 4+ guests, a separate local guide will be provided at each main destination (Bromo, Ijen, Madakaripura).
JVTO Travel T-Shirt: One complimentary JVTO branded T-shirt per person on every confirmed booking. Available in sizes XXS–XXL. Groups of 10+ pax receive a custom-designed group T-shirt.
Full Assistance: From your arrival to your final drop-off.
Quality Hotel Accommodation: including daily breakfast.
All Entrance Fees & Permits: to attractions
Meals: As mention in the itinerary
Private 4WD Jeep: For the Mount Bromo sunrise tour.
Health Screening: Ijen authorities require a doctor's health certificate. This will be conducted the evening before your trek. You only need your passport.
Gas Mask: Professional volcanic-grade gas mask provided for Ijen Crater routes. Mandatory during descent to crater floor due to H₂S/SO₂ gas.
Ferry Tickets: From Ketapang Harbour to Gilimanuk Harbour, Bali.
exclusions: International/Domestic Air Tickets: To and from your tour's starting and ending points.
Travel Insurance: Optional but highly recommended for peace of mind, covering trip interruptions, medical emergencies, and lost luggage.
Meals Not Stated in Itinerary: Specific lunches and additional dinners are at your own expense.
Personal Expenses: Such as snacks, souvenirs, beverages, laundry, etc. It is recommended to carry at least IDR 500,000 per person for these.
Tips: For drivers and guides (at your discretion).

itineraryDays.title: Arrival in Surabaya and Transfer to Tumpak Sewu Hotel
itineraryDays.summary:
Arrival in Surabaya and Transfer to Lumajang
The first day positions the route in Lumajang so the Tumpak Sewu exploration can begin comfortably the next morning. Pickup time in Surabaya is flexible and can be adjusted to match your flight or train arrival schedule—it does not have to be at 12:00. After pickup, the journey continues to Lumajang with a lunch stop along the way.

activities.name: Pickup and Transfer to Tumpak Sewu
activities.description: Pickup at your location in Surabaya and begin the transfer to the Tumpak Sewu area (Lumajang). This segment is the overland journey from the city to the waterfall area accommodation zone.

activities.name: Check-in at Tumpak Sewu Homestay
activities.description: Arrive at the Tumpak Sewu area and check in at the homestay/cottage. This is the scheduled arrival and check-in process so you can settle at the accommodation near the Tumpak Sewu area.

itineraryDays.title: Tumpak Sewu Exploration and Transfer Toward the Bromo Side
itineraryDays.summary:
Tumpak Sewu Exploration and Transfer Toward the Bromo Side
The day begins with a guided descent into the Tumpak Sewu valley to explore the main waterfall and surrounding river area. After completing the waterfall sequence, the route continues toward the Bromo side for the next morning’s early volcanic exploration.

activities.name: Tumpak Sewu Trekking
activities.description: Starting the Tumpak Sewu trekking. Begin the scheduled trekking session at Tumpak Sewu Waterfall, following the planned route on-site to experience the waterfall area during the allocated activity block.

activities.name: Lunch
activities.description: Lunch at a local restaurant (included). Take the planned lunch break after the trekking session, with time to sit down and eat before the long afternoon transfer.

activities.name: Transfer to Mount Bromo Area
activities.description: Starting the journey to the Mount Bromo area. Depart from the Tumpak Sewu area and begin the overland transfer to the Mount Bromo accommodation zone as scheduled.

activities.name: Check-in at Bromo Hotel
activities.description: Arrive at Bromo area and check-in hotel. Reach the Bromo area and complete hotel check-in, concluding the day’s relocation and preparing for the next morning’s Bromo program.

itineraryDays.title: Bromo Sunrise Exploration and Return to Surabaya
itineraryDays.summary:
Bromo Sunrise Exploration and Return to Surabaya
An early departure leads into the Bromo caldera for sunrise, the Sea of Sand, and the walk to the crater rim. After completing the Bromo sequence, return to the hotel for breakfast and check-out before continuing to Surabaya Airport or your Surabaya hotel, marking the end of the program.

activities.name: Bromo Jeep Tour Experience
activities.description: Starting the Bromo Jeep tour. Begin the sunrise tour sequence by Jeep in the Mount Bromo area, following the planned route flow for the morning program.

activities.name: Hotel Breakfast
activities.description: Back to the hotel for breakfast. Return from the Bromo morning program to the hotel and take a short breakfast break before check-out and departure.

activities.name: Bromo Hotel Check-out
activities.description: Check-out from the hotel. Complete the hotel check-out process and prepare for the overland transfer to Surabaya.

activities.name: Transfer to Surabaya
activities.description: Journey to Surabaya. Start the road transfer from the Bromo area to Surabaya as scheduled, concluding the Bromo segment for the day.

activities.name: Finish at Surabaya City
activities.description: Arrive in Surabaya and proceed with the final transfer to your requested drop-off (hotel/airport). Tour ends after drop-off completion.

faqs.question: What is Mount Bromo's current volcanic activity status?
faqs.answer: As of 2026-05-16, PVMBG elevated Mount Bromo to Level II Waspada, with a mandatory 1 km exclusion zone around the crater rim. The crater stairs and rim approach are currently off-limits to visitors. The Penanjakan sunrise viewpoint, Sea of Sand traverse, and caldera floor remain fully open and accessible. JVTO monitors PVMBG and BBKSDA advisories daily and contacts guests proactively if conditions change before departure.

faqs.question: Can I approach the Bromo crater rim?
faqs.answer: Under the current Level II Waspada status (in effect from 2026-05-16), a 1 km exclusion zone around the crater rim is mandated by PVMBG. JVTO does not take guests to the crater stairs or rim while Level II is active. The jeep drop-off area on the caldera floor, the Sea of Sand, and the Penanjakan viewpoint are all outside the exclusion zone and remain fully accessible.

faqs.question: Where is Tumpak Sewu located?
faqs.answer: On the border of Lumajang and Malang Regencies, East Java.

faqs.question: How much luggage can I bring?
faqs.answer:
In most cases, standard airline-style luggage is fine:

  • One main suitcase or backpack per person
  • One small daypack

If you plan to travel with unusually large or heavy items, please tell us in advance so we can plan the right vehicle. On days with hikes, we recommend leaving your main luggage in the car or accommodation and carrying only what you need in a daypack.

faqs.question: How can we contact JVTO before and during the tour?
faqs.answer:
Before and during your tour, our official channels are:

  • WhatsApp (primary)
  • Email

These details appear on your E-Voucher and on the Contact page. Please make sure your phone number (including country code) and email address are correct so we can reach you with any important updates.

faqs.question: How high is Tumpak Sewu?
faqs.answer: Approximately 120 meters, forming a circular amphitheater of waterfalls.

faqs.question: What is the altitude of Bromo?
What is included in the price?
faqs.answer:
Each tour page shows a clear list of Inclusions and Exclusions. In general, our private, all-inclusive packages cover:

  • Private vehicle and driver
  • Bromo 4WD jeep where listed
  • Stated park entrance tickets and permits
  • All hotel breakfasts
  • Selected lunches and dinners (especially during the Bondowoso / Ijen segment)
  • Mineral water
  • Essential gear for Ijen (gas mask and trekking pole) on tours that include Ijen
  • JVTO travel T-shirt (where listed)

Anything not listed under “Included” is treated as not included. For full details, please see Booking Information and the Inclusions & Exclusions section of your chosen tour.

faqs.question: What should I wear and bring for these tours?
faqs.answer:
The key is layering, grip and simplicity:

  • Layered clothing for cold pre-dawn starts and warmer later hours
  • Closed shoes with good grip (hiking shoes recommended for Ijen and Tumpak Sewu)
  • Small backpack, personal headlamp or torch, waterproof cover for electronics
  • Essential personal medication

We recommend keeping non-essential valuables and jewellery to a minimum, and avoiding silver items during Ijen days due to sulphur. For full details, see Packing & Fitness.

faqs.question: Which documents should I keep with me?
faqs.answer:
We recommend keeping the following easily accessible:

  • Passport and required visas
  • Travel insurance information
  • Your JVTO E-Voucher and contact details (printed or on your phone)
  • Any relevant medical information you may need to show in an emergency

faqs.question: What river feeds Tumpak Sewu?
faqs.answer: The Glidik River, originating from Mount Semeru’s volcanic slopes.

faqs.question: If it rains, will our tour be cancelled?
faqs.answer:
Light or normal rain rarely cancels an entire tour, but it can:

  • Make trails more slippery
  • Reduce visibility
  • Require changes in timing or route

Severe weather, landslides or dangerous conditions can lead to partial or full cancellations for safety. Our Weather & Closures page explains how we respond and how this links to Travel Credit and itinerary changes.

faqs.question: How do I book and confirm a tour?
faqs.answer:
The usual steps are:

  1. You send us your dates, origin (for example Surabaya or Bali), group size and preferred route.
  2. We send you a tailored proposal with itinerary and price.
  3. You confirm in writing and pay the booking deposit (normally 20% of the total).
  4. We send you an official JVTO E-Voucher with your booking details.

Your booking is considered confirmed when the deposit has been received and the E-Voucher has been issued. Full details are on the Booking Information page.

faqs.question: Do I need travel insurance?
faqs.answer:
Yes, we strongly recommend that all guests hold valid travel insurance that covers:

  • Medical emergencies
  • Evacuation and repatriation
  • Trip interruption and cancellations

JVTO operates as a licensed Indonesian tour operator, but we cannot act as an insurance provider and cannot cover costs that fall under personal insurance.

faqs.question: Where can I read the full legal policy?
faqs.answer:
The full legal text of our booking and cancellation terms is available on:

  • Booking Information (web page summary)
  • Booking & Cancellation Policy (document)

In any confusion, the combination of your JVTO E-Voucher, the Booking Information page and the official policy document is treated as the final reference.

faqs.question: What is the best sunrise viewpoint?
faqs.answer: Kingkong Hill (Bukit Kingkong) at 2,600 meters elevation.

faqs.question: How hard is the trek to the base?
faqs.answer: Moderate to hard (3.5/5), involving ropes, bamboo ladders, and slippery rocks.

faqs.question: Can visitors see Semeru from Tumpak Sewu?
faqs.answer: Yes, Semeru appears directly behind the falls from the upper viewpoint at sunrise.

faqs.question: What should you wear?
faqs.answer: Quick-dry clothes, sandals with grip, waterproof bag, and a light raincoat.
